reasoning: A classic six-pointed snowflake universally represents snow, winter weather, freezing, and air conditioning. It fits many practical household and seasonal tasks (defrosting freezers, servicing A/C units, snow removal, winterizing, freezing accounts) and is visually unmistakable except at tiny sizes where it can resemble an asterisk.
